212596: First lieutenant of the Sakuragi Family. Infamously known as "The Demon of Sakuragi".
252976: The sole daughter of the Sakuragi family boss. A timid girl who struggles at expressing her emotions.
252977: The leader of the Sakuragi family. He is strict with himself and others, but has a soft spot for Yaeka.
253008: Yaeka's aunt. Runs a restaurant called Kurosaki. Not intimidated by her brother-in-law Kazuhiko or Kirishima, she talks to all on equal footing. Her hobbies include dressing up Yaeka and Kirishima.
253009: A regional boss of the Sakuragi family. For better or worse, he's an honest guy. He gets very emotional, so people tend to tease him. With everything said and done, he respects Kirishima. His hobby is watching movies. His capacity to empathize with others is astounding.
253010: Toichiro's son. He's at the age where he copies everything his father does. He's a precocious little brat who does things without thinking them through. His hobbies are collecting free toys that you get when you order food and hitting on girls.
253011: The former right-hand man of the Sakuragi family. He's sociable and good at looking after others like a big brother. He's relatively short-tempered. His hobbies are going on drives and dismantling and remodeling things.
